annotations.title: Read the policy for an effect type

description: Shows how this workspace has configured a given effect type: whether it is allowed, how long a lease lasts, the attempt ceiling, spend limits, the approval threshold above which an action waits for a human, and — most importantly — what happens when an attempt ends indeterminate. Check this before designing a retry strategy.

effect_type.description: Namespaced kind of side effect, e.g. "email.send", "payment.charge", "github.pr.create". Policy is configured per type.
